policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="model" value="@{
        var body = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
        return body == null ? "" : ((string)body["model"] ?? "");
    }" />
    
      
        
          
          skipped; prompt=skipped; completion=skipped
          application/json
          @(new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(new JProperty("code", "model_not_allowed"), new JProperty("message", "This agent may not use model '" + (string)context.Variables["model"] + "'.")))).ToString())
        
      
    
    
    
    
    
      
      
    
    
    <set-variable name="prompt" value="@{
        var body = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
        var messages = body["messages"] as JArray;
        if (messages == null) { return ""; }
        for (int i = messages.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            if ((string)messages[i]["role"] == "user") {
                var content = messages[i]["content"];
                var text = content.Type == JTokenType.String ? (string)content : content.ToString();
                return text.Length > 9000 ? text.Substring(text.Length - 9000) : text;
            }
        }
        return "";
    }" />
    
      
        
          {{content-safety-endpoint}}contentsafety/text:shieldPrompt?api-version=2024-09-01
          POST
          application/json
          @(new JObject(new JProperty("userPrompt", (string)context.Variables["prompt"]), new JProperty("documents", new JArray())).ToString())
          
        
        
          {{content-safety-endpoint}}contentsafety/text:analyze?api-version=2024-09-01
          POST
          application/json
          @(new JObject(new JProperty("text", (string)context.Variables["prompt"]), new JProperty("outputType", "FourSeverityLevels")).ToString())
          
        
        <set-variable name="promptVerdict" value="@{
            var shield = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("shield");
            var harm = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("promptHarm");
            if (shield == null || harm == null || shield.StatusCode != 200 || harm.StatusCode != 200) { return "unavailable"; }
            var attack = shield.Body.As(preserveContent: true)["userPromptAnalysis"]?["attackDetected"];
            if (attack != null && (bool)attack) { return "block:prompt-attack"; }
            foreach (var c in (JArray)harm.Body.As(preserveContent: true)["categoriesAnalysis"]) {
                if ((int)c["severity"] >= {{content-safety-threshold}}) { return "block:" + (string)c["category"]; }
            }
            return "pass";
        }" />
        
          
            
              
              @((string)context.Variables["promptVerdict"] + "; prompt=" + (string)context.Variables["promptVerdict"] + "; completion=skipped")
              application/json
              {"error":{"code":"content_safety","message":"the prompt was blocked by Content Safety"}}
            
          
        
      
    
    
    
    Bearer {{groq-api-key}}
policies.outbound:
<set-variable name="completion" value="@{
        if (context.Response.StatusCode != 200) { return ""; }
        var body = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
        var text = (string)body["choices"]?[0]?["message"]?["content"] ?? "";
        return text.Length > 9000 ? text.Substring(0, 9000) : text;
    }" />
    
      
        
          {{content-safety-endpoint}}contentsafety/text:analyze?api-version=2024-09-01
          POST
          application/json
          @(new JObject(new JProperty("text", (string)context.Variables["completion"]), new JProperty("outputType", "FourSeverityLevels")).ToString())
          
        
        <set-variable name="completionVerdict" value="@{
            var harm = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("completionHarm");
            if (harm == null || harm.StatusCode != 200) { return "unavailable"; }
            foreach (var c in (JArray)harm.Body.As(preserveContent: true)["categoriesAnalysis"]) {
                if ((int)c["severity"] >= {{content-safety-threshold}}) { return "block:" + (string)c["category"]; }
            }
            return "pass";
        }" />
        
          
            
              
              @((string)context.Variables["completionVerdict"] + "; prompt=" + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("promptVerdict", "skipped") + "; completion=" + (string)context.Variables["completionVerdict"])
              application/json
              {"error":{"code":"content_safety","message":"the completion was blocked by Content Safety"}}
            
          
        
      
    
    
    
      @{
            var p = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("promptVerdict", "skipped");
            var c = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("completionVerdict", "skipped");
            var all = p.StartsWith("block") ? p : c.StartsWith("block") ? c
                : (p == "unavailable" || c == "unavailable") ? "unavailable"
                : (p + c) == "skippedskipped" ? "skipped" : "pass";
            return all + "; prompt=" + p + "; completion=" + c;
        }

set-header.name: x-content-safety
